# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 29 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Market Prices at a Glance

- **Private home prices up 0.5% in Q2 2026, led by landed homes** - URA's latest data shows the overall private residential property price index rose 0.5% QoQ in Q2 2026, easing from the 0.9% gain in Q1, with landed homes driving the increase. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-q2-2026-report-breakdown/)

- **HDB resale prices dipped 0.3% in Q2 2026 — second consecutive quarterly decline** - HDB's quarterly statistics show the Resale Price Index slipped 0.3% QoQ in Q2 2026, even as transaction activity edged higher. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-prices-fell-in-q2-2026-as-market-continues-to-stabilise/)

- **Condo resale volumes rebounded in June 2026** - Singapore's private resale condo market saw prices hold largely flat while transaction volumes picked up in June 2026, reflecting a period of stabilisation. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-volumes-rebounded-in-june-2026-as-buyers-returned-to-the-secondary-market/)

## Policy & Regulation Updates

- **15-month wait-out period for private property owners buying HDB resale flats removed** - The Government has removed the 15-month wait-out period with immediate effect, citing signs that the HDB resale market has stabilised after several years of rapid price growth. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/15-month-period-removed-for-private-property-owners-buying-hdb-resale/)

- **Revised ABSD rules give developers up to seven years to complete and sell large en bloc redevelopment projects** - From 29 July, the revised rules also introduce new sales deadlines and unit ratio requirements for large en bloc redevelopment sites. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/developers-face-easier-time-selling-large-enbloc-projects-but-not-sure-win-for-en-bloc-hopefuls/)

## New Launch Snapshot

- **Dunearn House sold 56% at its July launch weekend, with three-bedroom units fully taken up** - Dunearn House moved 211 of 380 units (55.5%) over its July 25–26 launch weekend; Three-Bedroom and Three-Bedroom + Flexi units sold out completely, though overall take-up trailed the 2026 new launch average of 75.8%. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/dunearn-house-sold-55-at-launch-but-one-unit-type-sold-out-completely/)
